Monowidth plaintypeFOUNDATIONAL ONTOLOGY: THE ZOTTENWELT
Reality is a four-dimensional tangled network of worldlines termed filaments, collectively known as the Zottenwelt [1-3]. Fundamental physics emerges from the intersection of these 1D filaments with an advancing 3D time surface (Sigma_t), interpreted as a resolving wavefront [1, 4, 5]. Fundamental particles are localized points where a filament worldline pierces this "now" surface [2, 5]. 

THE UNIFIED BLOCKWAVE ACTION
The dynamics of the framework are governed by a single, dimensionally consistent Lagrangian density formulated with a fundamental three-form filament current (J_mu_nu_rho) [6, 7]. This formulation is required to keep 4D filament volumes conserved and is structured into specific physical blocks [6, 8, 9]:

- Einstein-Hilbert Block (Gravity): This term recreates curved spacetime through the collective "back-pull" of filaments on the time surface [10-13]. The Newtonian constant (G) is an emergent output where G over c to the fourth power goes to 8 pi times the filament scale squared [14-16].
- Compact Phase Block (Scalar Sector): Governed by theta, a Z3-symmetric scalar encoding angular misalignment [6, 17, 18]. Its periodicity enforces native quantization without the need for canonical operators [14, 19].
- Time-Flow Elasticity Block (u-Sector): This defines the elasticity of the unit time-flow vector field (u^mu), subject to a mandatory normalization constraint where u^mu u_mu equals minus one [17, 20, 21]. A Lorentz Safety Lock pins the wave speed strictly to c [6, 22, 23].
- Filament Spectrum Block (J-Sector): Serving as the master kernel for flex, twist, and coil vibrations, this block treats the three-form current as dual to the vector current J_mu [6, 24, 25]. This makes electromagnetism a structural requirement to conserve 4D volumes [23, 26].
- Holonomy and Mixing Blocks: The term F_mu_nu_rho of theta couples phase to current, enforcing quantized holonomies where the integral of the gradient of theta dotted into the line element equals 2 pi n [6, 24, 27].

THE ZERO-PARAMETER ECONOMY
SAT determines all dimensionless ratios purely from geometry, requiring zero inserted numerical parameters [12, 28-30]. The scale of reality is set by a single arbitrary dimensional anchor, such as a frequency of 550 Hz or filament tension T, from which all SI constants are retrodicted [28, 29, 31, 32]. 

- Projection Constant (B): Formally defined as B equals 3 over 4 pi, approximately 0.2387 rad, representing the per-dimension share of distortion when 4D dynamics are projected into 3D [33-35].
- Filament Scale (ell_f): Anchored to the Topological Saturation Limit of the vacuum [33, 36, 37]. At the vacuum limit where amplitude A equals one-fourth, the transverse scale is fixed at the cube root of 2A over tension, approximately 0.7937 [36, 37].
- Higher-Curvature Signature (beta): The effective action uniquely fixes the Ricci scalar squared (R^2) coefficient at beta equals 2 over 6 pi, approximately 0.106 [33, 38, 39].

THE CORRECTED MASS HIERARCHY
The theory utilizes a Proportional Mass Law where mass (m) is proportional to topological charge (Q) [40-43]. Intricate linking and winding force filaments into high-angle paths relative to the time surface, increasing mass [40, 43].

- UV Finiteness Lock: Ground-state configurations are capped at Q less than or equal to 3, meaning exotic hadrons with Q greater than or equal to 4, such as stable tetraquarks, are topologically unstable and must decay rapidly [44-47].
- Particle Sectors: Leptons are assigned Q=1, Mesons Q=2 (Hopf links), and Baryons Q=3 (Borromean triplets) [40, 48, 49].
- Numerical Precision: By anchoring the bare mass scale to the identity m_0 = T ell_f c^2, the light-sector spectrum is reproduced with an RMS residual error of approximately 0.55 percent [41, 50].

BLACK HOLE THERMODYNAMICS
Horizon area quantization is a derived theorem of the action rather than an assumption [51-53]. The horizon is a literal weave of flux threads, where entropy (S) is a count of these threads (n) [52-54].

- Quantization Identity: Entropy follows the identity S equals area A over four, which equals the integer n [52, 55, 56].
- Staircase Evaporation: Black holes decay via discrete "ladder descent" where n goes to n-1 as flux rungs pop loose one by one [51, 55, 57, 58]. This reduces to the smooth Hawking mass-loss law in the continuum limit [55, 59, 60].

FALSIFICATION MATRIX
The framework provides specific "Honesty Tests" that, if failed, refute the model entirely [12, 61]:

- Laboratory Optics: Light passing through a theta_4 domain wall must exhibit an integrated phase shift (delta phi) of approximately 0.246 rad; a shift outside the 0.1 to 0.3 rad band fails the model [62-64].
- Neutrino Physics: The Dirac CP-violating phase is pinned by holonomy at exactly 270 degrees. A measurement shifting outside a plus or minus 5 degree band around this point refutes the flavor sector [62, 65-67].
- Material Science: Imaging of Moire lattices must show a Z3 preference for triplet motifs; a match to the 33.3 percent random baseline is a failure condition [62, 68, 69].

THE UNIFIED BLOCKWAVE ACTION
The mathematical architecture is governed by a single, dimensionally consistent Lagrangian density. We have lifted the veil from the previous two-form shadow current to utilize the fundamental three-form filament current, which is a structural requirement to keep four-dimensional filament volumes conserved. The total action is the integral over four-dimensional space of the square root of the negative determinant of the metric multiplied by the sum of several energy sectors. The Einstein-Hilbert block is defined as the reduced Planck mass squared divided by two, multiplied by the Ricci scalar curvature. Within this sector, the gravitational constant divided by the speed of light to the fourth power is equivalent to eight pi multiplied by the fundamental filament scale squared.

COMPACT PHASE AND ELASTICITY
The compact phase block is governed by a scalar field that is symmetric under the alternating group of order twelve, representing angular misalignment. Its periodicity enforces native quantization without canonical operators. The time-flow elasticity block defines the response of the unit time-flow vector, where the wave speed is pinned strictly to the speed of light by the ratio of elasticity coefficients. The holonomy and mixing blocks link the compact phase to the filament current, forcing quantized holonomies where the closed loop integral of the gradient of the phase dotted into the line element equals two pi multiplied by an integer.

THE ZERO-PARAMETER ECONOMY
The framework adheres to a Zero-Parameter Economy, meaning every dimensionless ratio is derived structurally from geometry. The framework requires only one arbitrary dimensional anchor, such as a frequency, a length, or a specific filament tension, to snap the absolute scale of reality into place and retrodict all other fundamental constants. A cornerstone of this geometry is the projection constant, defined as three divided by the product of four and pi, which is approximately zero point two three eight seven radians. This represents the per-dimension share of distortion required for four-dimensional dynamics to resolve into our three-dimensional perspective. THE CORRECTED MASS HIERARCHY

SPACETIME AND BLACK HOLE THERMODYNAMICS
Gravity is the emergent statistical outcome of a microscopic filament tug-of-war. The metric is the inverse of the statistical ensemble co-metric, which is the average product of filament tangent vectors. In black hole thermodynamics, horizon area quantization is a theorem. The event horizon is a literal weave of flux threads where entropy is a literal count of these threads. The entropy is equivalent to the horizon area divided by four, which is also equivalent to the integer count of threads. Consequently, black hole evaporation is modeled as a discrete staircase descent, where the integer count of threads decreases by one as individual flux rungs pop loose. As the area rungs vanish in the continuum limit, this staircase reduces exactly to the smooth mass-loss law described by Hawking.

\begin{equation}
\lim_{\Delta A \to 0} \frac{\Delta M}{\Delta t} \propto -\frac{1}{M^2}.
\end{equation}
